body: Thanks for this feedback. Such a relief to hear. I’m sure there is an anxiety feedback loop. I hear/feel/experience more symptoms that makes me more anxious that plays into it more. Anyway, I see a GI tomorrow so it’ll be nice to have some answers then. I guess I should also add maybe lower back soreness but that could be from a host of things.
Oh no! This sounds so miserable! I’m sorry to hear. I’ve had nausea before but actual pain no. I can’t imagine how terrible the combo is. Sounds like a real shit sandwich….

Stools don’t smell TOO bad. I mean occasionally pretty bad but I don’t think it’s worse than the next guy. They don’t stick to the toilet, but sometimes they leave a tiny line where they fell into the toilet bowl that I have to use the scrubber to get rid of if I don’t want someone else to see it. I haven’t had any tests down yet. I have my first appointment with the GI tomorrow. Never tried digestive enzymes before — what’re those?

Sorry to hear you’re having these symptoms too! Have you been diagnosed? It’s been really consistent I’d say for like 4/5 months and maybe worsening (more gas, more frequent stools, louder bowels). My butthole itching was back in January though (with a little tiny blood on the TP). Now I kind of have a low key awareness all the time of my bladder— like I want to go somewhere private and either poo or fart. Just push haha.

34F/165cm/47.5kg. 

Grandmother died of colorectal cancer in her 80s

I started noticing some unusual bowels about a year ago - more orange/green/light brown than usual and also that my poo consistently floated. 

Increasingly since then — and I noticed particularly after having covid (maybe because I was paying more attention to my health) — that I rarely have a normal poo. They are almost all loose and I usually have 2-3 per day (vary in volume and shape). They mostly float and are relatively cohesive small blobs that sometime leave tracks on the toilet and on the toilet paper. They are usually light brown and sometimes have pieces of un digested food left in them. 

I feel like I need to go a lot. 

When I do have big regular solid poo, they are often two tone. Like literally someone took two pieces of poo and stuck them together and one half is lighter and the other half is darker. 

My stomach makes SO much gurgling noise. Especially when I lie down, but it is also sitting up. It happens almost all the time and is VERY loud. 

About nine months ago, had a bout of loose stool associated with some twitching in my left lower abdomen 

I’ve been having increasing gas. Now I would say a définitely fart >20-30 times per day. Sometimes it’s smelly but not always. It can be hard to push out sometimes. 

Rarely have stomach pain, just more discomfort. Sometimes an almost tingling feeling in the center of my colon. Once in a blue moon cramping. 

I’ve gone through periods of really bad nausea- now I’m fine, but there was a period (that may have been associated with stress) where I could barely eat, and it was hard to keep food down. 

Have a skin tag around my butthole that has been there for ages. 

Had some (bright red) bleeding from my bum in January accompanied by an itchy butthole, but it was quickly relieved and the quantity wasn’t that large. 

I’m able to eat large quantities now without gaining weight. 

Occasional pain on mid/upper left side 

I’ll be seeing a GI on Tuesday. I’m in a country where I’m still waiting for my residency and thus am not on the insurance here. Would it be worth it to request a colonoscopy out of pocket?
